title: How to Connect FanBase to Claude or ChatGPT - FanBase - Gamified Fan Engagement Platform
snippet:
- A FanBase account with at least one platform connected (Instagram, TikTok, Discord, etc.)
- Claude, ChatGPT, or any tool supporting custom MCPs.

### In Claude
- Go to Settings → Connectors (enable Developer Mode first if you don't see this)
- Select Add connector and add the MCP URL ([https://api.copilot.fanbase.gg/mcp](https://api.copilot.fanbase.gg/mcp))
![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/WreEUaaUNVebhJjW5ZSH1t1Lm8I.png)

- No API keys involved, so there's nothing to leak.
- You control what it's allowed to do, and can revoke access anytime from FanBase → Settings → AI Connections, effective immediately.

title: commas-cli
snippet:
# Commas CLI
Run your [Commas](https://commas.com) (formerly FanBasis) business from the terminal. The CLI is a thin client for the Commas MCP server — every command maps to an MCP tool, so the CLI automatically stays in sync with the server's capabilities.

```
commas login                 # prompts for your API key (stored in ~/.commas/config.json, mode 0600)
commas status                # server health + current config
commas tools                 # list every tool the server exposes
```

Commands run against **production** (`https://www.fanbasis.com`) by default. The sandbox is `https://api-sandbox.commas.net` and needs its own API key, created in the sandbox dashboard at [https://sandbox.commas.net](https://sandbox.commas.net) (Account → API Keys). Keys from the old QA dashboard (qa.dev-fan-basis.com) do not work there. Check and add one with:
```
commas keys list                  # which environments have a key
commas keys add sandbox           # prompts for the key, no echo
```
If you ask for sandbox without one, the command stops and tells you — it will never quietly fall back to production.
The server tracks production vs sandbox per MCP session, so the CLI persists your choice locally and re-applies it on every run:
```
commas env               # show current default
commas env sandbox       # all future commands run against the sandbox
commas env production
commas tx list --env sandbox   # one-off override
```
If the sandbox switch fails, the command aborts rather than silently running against production.

## Configuration
Resolution order: command flags → environment variables → `~/.commas/config.json` → defaults.
| Setting | Flag | Env var | Config key |
|---|---|---|---|
| API key | `--api-key` | `COMMAS_API_KEY` | `apiKey` |
| Server URL | `--server` | `COMMAS_MCP_URL` | `serverUrl` |
| Environment | `--env` | `COMMAS_ENV` | `environment` |
Default server: `https://hearty-flow-production.up.railway.app/mcp`

title: FanBasis MCP Server - MCP AI | Zapier
snippet:
Zapier FanBasis MCP lets you connect FanBasis's actions with any AI tool that supports MCP, all without managing integrations or writing glue code. It's built for developers who want flexibility without complexity.
### Step 1: Generate your secure MCP URL
Get your unique, dynamic MCP server URL instantly. This endpoint securely connects your AI assistant to Zapier's vast integration network.
### Step 2: Choose your Zapier Actions
Customize the specific actions your AI assistant can perform within FanBasis. Select and scope actions to align with your FanBasis workflows.

### Step 3: Connect with your tool of choice
Integrate your AI Assistant seamlessly using your generated MCP endpoint, enabling your AI Assistant to execute real-world tasks securely and reliably.

title: FanBase MCP Developer Guide · Connect AI Agents to Your Community
snippet:
Three simple steps to connect FanBase to the AI tool you already use.
1
### Install the MCP to ChatGPT or Claude
Add FanBase as a custom connector in a couple of clicks. [Discover how →](https://copilot.fanbase.gg/docs)
2
### Authenticate with your FanBase account
Sign in like you always do. No API keys to copy or paste.
3
### Unlock all FanBase features in your AI tool
From there, just ask, your assistant can see your community and act on it.
### Connect accounts
### Post and schedule
### Answer comments and DMs
### Access analytics
### Add skills

Built to protect your account and your audience, every step of the way.
Official API access only
Connects through each platform’s official API — never scraping, never faking logins.
Your data stays yours
Your data is never used to train AI models — it only answers your questions and acts on your behalf, nothing else.
No keys to leak
Sign in with your own FanBase account — nothing to copy, paste, or accidentally expose.
